_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A Return clicked before the delayed draft resolves does not navigate after cancel. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). The server's answer to the browser's draft creation is held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft, and call "draftAnswered" whether the browser has received the answer. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button.
2. Call "draftCreated" until it returns "true".
3. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The recorder should float.
4. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"], then click the cancel button. No recording panel should remain (count 0).
5. Call "releaseDraft", then call "draftAnswered" until it returns "true".
6. The URL should end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
7. The voice button should be enabled, and the URL must still end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
